cells.tense: You are here where direction gets decided and it is already settled.
cells.act: trace the pattern across the last few times
cells.ask: Look back over your last few decisions and trace the pattern running through them — then keep choosing exactly as you do now.
cells.core:
You pick a direction and then you live inside it, and the picking doesn't burn you up. The shape underneath your choices is visible to you without becoming a problem: you can watch how you decide and still decide, and that is what keeps the shine from needing to be announced. It shows because it's there, not because you're holding it up.

What's worth doing next is keeping sight of that shape without handling it. Look back over your last few decisions and trace the pattern running through them. No new plan, no fix to make, no revision of the course. Only the pattern, named in one sentence or left unsaid. If it's true it will still be true after the week, and you'll know you can look at your own machinery while it keeps running.
cells.sheetLine: You can watch how you choose and still choose.
cells.verb: let what you actually are come through in what you choose

cells.tense: You will keep arriving early, forcing a direction before it can carry weight.
cells.act: open the thing you have been assuming you knew and look at it unlabelled
cells.ask: Study one thing you've settled on for ten minutes with no name on it, and don't change anything after.
cells.core:
Somewhere in how you choose, you have stopped being the one who points and become the light you point at. A decision doesn't get made and lived; it gets held up, and that grip runs past the deciding, so you are several steps into a future you wrote before you got there.

So let one matter stay open that you thought you had closed. Pick something you are sure about — the shape of the next months, a person, a plan — and study it for ten minutes with none of your names for it. What it is, before you say what it is. You don't have to change anything afterward. The point is to see what is actually here, not what you already announced was coming.
cells.sheetLine: You're early to the future instead of in it.
cells.verb: let what you actually are come through in what you choose

cells.tense: You kept the direction small so no one would have to look at you.
cells.act: decide from what is here now, not from habit
cells.ask: When the next small choice comes up, decide it from what's true this afternoon, not from what you've done before.
cells.core:
Where you decide, you have stopped standing at the front. Choices get made and then filed under circumstance — it happened to go that way, anyone would have done it. But the direction keeps being set, and the hand on it is yours, and you talk as if it isn't.

So charge the deciding itself. Let the next small choice arrive — not one you go looking for — and make it from what is actually true this afternoon rather than from how you've answered so far. Then stand beside it instead of off to the side. No announcement, no bigness, no extra effort. Doing one on purpose tells you whether the light is still there, and it needs no one else around to count.
cells.sheetLine: Decide the next small thing from now, not habit.
cells.verb: let what you actually are come through in what you choose

cells.tense: You are making the choices and not noticing that you are the one making them.
cells.act: notice what is newly here, right now
cells.ask: Take note of whatever has just arrived — a choice, a turn, a door — whenever it happens to cross you.
cells.core:
You are steering and you would not say steering is happening. Direction gets set — a no here, a yes there, a thing released because you decided so — and it all gets filed under how things are. Some of what's being filed as stopped is still moving.

So catch the turn as it comes. When something new crosses you — something that arrived, a choice that just came up, a door that just opened — take note of it. Nothing more than noticing. You're not asked to make anything of it. That noticing is the whole practice. What is arriving gets met when somebody recognizes it is arriving, and you are that somebody here.
cells.sheetLine: You make the choices. Start seeing your hand in them.
cells.verb: let what you actually are come through in what you choose
